description: This file is a shell script used for testing the standalone functionality of gitweb, a web interface for Git repositories. It includes setup, test cases for snapshot generation, project forks, security checks, and HTML output validation.

methods.name: check_snapshot
methods.description: Function to verify snapshot filename and tar contents based on provided basename and prefix.

methods.name: xss
methods.description: Function to check for proper quoting of potentially dangerous input to prevent XSS.

methods.name: no_http_equiv_content_type
methods.description: Function to verify absence of 'http-equiv=content-type' in HTML output.

methods.name: proper_doctype
methods.description: Function to verify correct DOCTYPE and entity declarations in HTML output.
